summary: Wednesday after work Ethan and Seoyun come by: the 'something to do together' is Dad's 텃밭. Ethan grows peppers too (smaller). Dad's mother in Korea talked to her plants. The girls played there as kids (Seoyun once ate one of the peppers and drank a ton of water; Seohyun kept laughing). The wedding is next month and Dad is 'not sure'. He asks about Ethan's military computer job and after 전역 (in two years), mentions a former coworker who did military computer work and now works at a big company, asks Ethan to come garden together, and gives him his biggest pepper -- which he never does.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지가 같이 할 일이 있다고 했다. 수요일 저녁, 이선은 퇴근하고 서윤이와 같이 서윤이 부모님 집에 갔다. 아버지는 집 밖에 있었다.
paragraphs.en: Father had said there was something to do together. Wednesday evening, after work, Ethan went to Seoyun's parents' house with her. Her father was outside.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: 왔어요? 여기 와 봐요. 이게 내 텃밭이에요.
paragraphs.en: Father: You're here? Come take a look. This is my garden.

paragraphs.ko: 텃밭에는 빨간 고추가 많았다.
paragraphs.en: The garden was full of red peppers.

paragraphs.ko: 이선: 고추가 정말 크네요! 저도 집에서 키워요.
paragraphs.en: Ethan: These peppers are really big! I grow them at home too.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: 정말요? 이선 씨도요?
paragraphs.en: Father: Really? You too?

paragraphs.ko: 이선: 네. 근데 제 건 너무 작아요.
paragraphs.en: Ethan: Yes. But mine are really small.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지가 처음으로 크게 웃었다.
paragraphs.en: For the first time, Father laughed out loud.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: 매일 봐야 돼요. 물도 주고, 말도 하고.
paragraphs.en: Father: You have to check on them every day. Water them, talk to them too.

paragraphs.ko: 이선: 말을 해요?
paragraphs.en: Ethan: You talk to them?

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: 네. 한국에서 살던 집에도 이런 게 있었어요. 우리 어머니가 매일 그렇게 했어요.
paragraphs.en: Father: Yes. The house I lived in back in Korea had one of these too. My mother did that every day.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지는 의자에 앉았다.
paragraphs.en: Father sat down on a chair.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: 여기는 서현이랑 서윤이가 아이였을 때 놀던 곳이에요.
paragraphs.en: Father: This is where Seohyun and Seoyun used to play when they were kids.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: 서윤이는 여기서 하나를 먹고 물을 정말 많이 마셨어요. 서현이는 옆에서 계속 웃었고요.
paragraphs.en: Father: Seoyun once ate one of these out here and drank a ton of water. Seohyun just kept laughing next to her.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지는 잠깐 하늘을 봤다.
paragraphs.en: Father looked up at the sky for a moment.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: 그때 웃던 아이가 다음 달에 결혼식을 해요. 나는 아직… 잘 모르겠어요.
paragraphs.en: Father: That kid who was laughing is having her wedding next month. I'm still... not sure how I feel.

paragraphs.ko: 이선은 말없이 아버지 옆에 앉았다.
paragraphs.en: Ethan sat down next to him without a word.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: 이선 씨는 군인이죠? 서윤이가 그랬어요.
paragraphs.en: Father: You're in the military, right? Seoyun told me.

paragraphs.ko: 이선: 네. 군인이고, 컴퓨터 일을 해요.
paragraphs.en: Ethan: Yes. I'm in the military, and I do computer work.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: 일은 힘들지 않아요? 전역하면 뭐 할 거예요?
paragraphs.en: Father: Isn't the work hard? What will you do when you get out?

paragraphs.ko: 이선: 이 년 후에 전역해요. 아직 잘 모르겠어요. 근데 컴퓨터 일은 계속하고 싶어요.
paragraphs.en: Ethan: I get out in two years. I'm not sure yet. But I want to keep doing computer work.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: 내가 다니던 회사에 군인일 때 컴퓨터 일을 하던 사람이 있었어요. 지금은 큰 회사에서 일해요.
paragraphs.en: Father: At the company I used to work for, there was a guy who did computer work when he was in the military. He works at a big company now.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: 걱정하지 마요. 이선 씨도 잘 될 거예요. 그리고 다음에도 와서 같이 일해요. 혼자 하면 힘들어요.
paragraphs.en: Father: Don't worry. You'll do well too. And come again so we can work out here together. It's hard doing it alone.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지는 가장 큰 걸 하나 이선에게 줬다.
paragraphs.en: Father gave Ethan the biggest one.

paragraphs.ko: 아버지: 이거 받아요. 이선 씨 거보다 클 거예요.
paragraphs.en: Father: Take this. I bet it's bigger than yours.

paragraphs.ko: 집 안에서 서윤이가 그걸 봤다.
paragraphs.en: Inside the house, Seoyun saw it.

paragraphs.ko: 서윤: 아빠가 고추를 줬어? 아빠는 그거 누구한테도 안 줘!
paragraphs.en: Seoyun: Dad gave you a pepper? Dad never gives those to anyone!

questions.prompt_en: What was the garden spot in the old days?
When does Ethan leave the military?

questions.prompt_ko: "여기는 딸들이 아이였을 때 놀___ 곳이에요." 빈칸에 뭐가 들어가요?
questions.prompt_en: "This is the place where my daughters ___ play when they were kids."
